exercises.problemHtml:
Every record type of LabFlow, one question each (lab/out/c32-hoi), then how Node reads them (c32-node):

$ dig +noall +answer labflow.test A
labflow.test.		289	IN	A	203.0.113.10
$ dig +noall +answer labflow.test AAAA
labflow.test.		300	IN	AAAA	2001:db8:d::10
$ dig +noall +answer www.labflow.test
www.labflow.test.	300	IN	CNAME	labflow.test.
labflow.test.		289	IN	A	203.0.113.10
$ dig +noall +answer static.labflow.test
static.labflow.test.	300	IN	CNAME	labflow.cdn.test.
labflow.cdn.test.	51	IN	A	203.0.113.10
$ dig +noall +answer labflow.test MX
labflow.test.		300	IN	MX	10 mail.labflow.test.
$ dig +noall +answer mail.labflow.test
mail.labflow.test.	300	IN	A	203.0.113.25
$ dig +noall +answer labflow.test TXT
labflow.test.		300	IN	TXT	"labflow-verify=7f3c9a1e"
labflow.test.		300	IN	TXT	"v=spf1 mx -all"
$ dig +noall +answer _dmarc.labflow.test TXT
_dmarc.labflow.test.	300	IN	TXT	"v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@labflow.test"
$ dig +noall +answer labflow.test CAA
labflow.test.		300	IN	CAA	0 issue "letsencrypt.org"
$ dig +noall +answer _mongodb._tcp.db.labflow.test SRV
_mongodb._tcp.db.labflow.test. 300 IN	SRV	0 0 27017 db1.labflow.test.
_mongodb._tcp.db.labflow.test. 300 IN	SRV	0 0 27017 db2.labflow.test.
$ dig +noall +answer labflow.test HTTPS
labflow.test.		300	IN	HTTPS	1 . alpn="h2" ipv4hint=203.0.113.10
$ dig +noall +answer labflow.test NS
labflow.test.		86389	IN	NS	ns2.labflow.test.
labflow.test.		86389	IN	NS	ns1.labflow.test.
$ dig +noall +answer labflow.test SOA
labflow.test.		3600	IN	SOA	ns1.labflow.test. hostmaster.labflow.test. 2026110101 3600 600 1209600 300

$ node /tmp/ghi.mjs
MX   [ { exchange: 'mail.labflow.test', priority: 10 } ]
TXT  [ [ 'labflow-verify=7f3c9a1e' ], [ 'v=spf1 mx -all' ] ]
CAA  [ { critical: 0, issue: 'letsencrypt.org' } ]
SRV  [
  { name: 'db1.labflow.test', port: 27017, priority: 0, weight: 0 },
  { name: 'db2.labflow.test', port: 27017, priority: 0, weight: 0 }
]
TXT  [ [ 'replicaSet=rs0&authSource=admin' ] ]

This set has 6 questions. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. Work each one out yourself first (on paper or in the lab), then check — every explanation after Submit says why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanation of every question appears after you submit.

solutionCodeJson.code:
# Records 1 — Which record answers which question? — answer key

1. A mail server wants to deliver to someone@labflow.test. What does it look up, and what does it get?Một máy chủ thư muốn giao thư cho someone@labflow.test. Nó tra gì, và nhận được gì?
   Answer: b) MX → the name mail.labflow.test (priority 10), then that name's A record
   MX always holds a NAME, never an IP; the sender then resolves that name (203.0.113.25). Lower priority wins when there are several.VI: MX luôn chứa một TÊN, không bao giờ là IP; bên gửi sau đó tra tên đó (203.0.113.25). Nếu có nhiều MX, số ưu tiên nhỏ hơn thắng.

2. labflow.test has two TXT records. What are they for?labflow.test có hai bản ghi TXT. Chúng để làm gì?
   Answer: c) One proves domain ownership to a service, one lists who may send mail (SPF)
   TXT is free text, used as a channel: "labflow-verify=…" is a verification token a service asked you to publish; "v=spf1 mx -all" says only the MX hosts may send mail for the domain. DMARC lives at _dmarc.labflow.test.VI: TXT là chữ tự do, dùng như một kênh: "labflow-verify=…" là mã xác minh một dịch vụ bảo bạn công bố; "v=spf1 mx -all" nói chỉ các máy MX mới được gửi thư cho tên miền. DMARC nằm ở _dmarc.labflow.test.

3. What does `0 issue "letsencrypt.org"` (CAA) change?`0 issue "letsencrypt.org"` (CAA) thay đổi điều gì?
   Answer: a) Certificate authorities other than Let's Encrypt must refuse to issue a certificate for labflow.test
   CAs must check CAA before issuing. Browsers never read it. No CAA at all (like cuongthai.com) means any CA may issue.VI: CA phải kiểm CAA trước khi cấp. Trình duyệt không bao giờ đọc nó. Không có CAA (như cuongthai.com) nghĩa là CA nào cũng được cấp.

4. A connection string says mongodb+srv://db.labflow.test. What does the driver look up?Chuỗi kết nối ghi mongodb+srv://db.labflow.test. Driver tra gì?
   Answer: c) SRV _mongodb._tcp.db.labflow.test (hosts + ports) and TXT db.labflow.test (options)
   SRV gives priority, weight, port and target name for each member; the TXT adds replicaSet and authSource. Node prints exactly that from resolveSrv and resolveTxt.VI: SRV cho ưu tiên, trọng số, cổng và tên đích của từng thành viên; TXT thêm replicaSet và authSource. Node in đúng như vậy từ resolveSrv và resolveTxt.

5. The NS answer shows TTL 86389 while the zone says 86400. Why?Câu trả lời NS ghi TTL 86389 trong khi vùng ghi 86400. Vì sao?
   Answer: c) It came from the resolver's cache, which counts the TTL down
   The resolver met the NS set 11 seconds earlier while resolving other names. A cached answer shows the time left; the authoritative server always shows the full value (lesson 3.3).VI: Resolver đã gặp bộ NS 11 giây trước khi tra những tên khác. Câu trả lời từ cache cho thấy thời gian còn lại; máy chủ có thẩm quyền luôn cho giá trị đầy đủ (bài 3.3).

6. What does the HTTPS record `1 . alpn="h2" ipv4hint=203.0.113.10` give a browser?Bản ghi HTTPS `1 . alpn="h2" ipv4hint=203.0.113.10` cho trình duyệt điều gì?
   Answer: d) Before connecting, it learns that the server speaks HTTP/2 and a likely address
   RFC 9460: "." = same name, alpn = protocols, hints = addresses. Cloudflare also publishes ech= keys there (see media.cuongthai.com in lesson 3.4).VI: RFC 9460: "." = cùng tên, alpn = giao thức, hint = địa chỉ. Cloudflare còn công bố khoá ech= ở đó (xem media.cuongthai.com ở bài 3.4).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
Answer key / Đáp án

  1. b) MX → the name mail.labflow.test (priority 10), then that name's A record

    MX always holds a NAME, never an IP; the sender then resolves that name (203.0.113.25). Lower priority wins when there are several.

    VI: MX luôn chứa một TÊN, không bao giờ là IP; bên gửi sau đó tra tên đó (203.0.113.25). Nếu có nhiều MX, số ưu tiên nhỏ hơn thắng.

  2. c) One proves domain ownership to a service, one lists who may send mail (SPF)

    TXT is free text, used as a channel: "labflow-verify=…" is a verification token a service asked you to publish; "v=spf1 mx -all" says only the MX hosts may send mail for the domain. DMARC lives at _dmarc.labflow.test.

    VI: TXT là chữ tự do, dùng như một kênh: "labflow-verify=…" là mã xác minh một dịch vụ bảo bạn công bố; "v=spf1 mx -all" nói chỉ các máy MX mới được gửi thư cho tên miền. DMARC nằm ở _dmarc.labflow.test.

  3. a) Certificate authorities other than Let's Encrypt must refuse to issue a certificate for labflow.test

    CAs must check CAA before issuing. Browsers never read it. No CAA at all (like cuongthai.com) means any CA may issue.

    VI: CA phải kiểm CAA trước khi cấp. Trình duyệt không bao giờ đọc nó. Không có CAA (như cuongthai.com) nghĩa là CA nào cũng được cấp.

  4. c) SRV _mongodb._tcp.db.labflow.test (hosts + ports) and TXT db.labflow.test (options)

    SRV gives priority, weight, port and target name for each member; the TXT adds replicaSet and authSource. Node prints exactly that from resolveSrv and resolveTxt.

    VI: SRV cho ưu tiên, trọng số, cổng và tên đích của từng thành viên; TXT thêm replicaSet và authSource. Node in đúng như vậy từ resolveSrv và resolveTxt.

  5. c) It came from the resolver's cache, which counts the TTL down

    The resolver met the NS set 11 seconds earlier while resolving other names. A cached answer shows the time left; the authoritative server always shows the full value (lesson 3.3).

    VI: Resolver đã gặp bộ NS 11 giây trước khi tra những tên khác. Câu trả lời từ cache cho thấy thời gian còn lại; máy chủ có thẩm quyền luôn cho giá trị đầy đủ (bài 3.3).

  6. d) Before connecting, it learns that the server speaks HTTP/2 and a likely address

    RFC 9460: "." = same name, alpn = protocols, hints = addresses. Cloudflare also publishes ech= keys there (see media.cuongthai.com in lesson 3.4).

    VI: RFC 9460: "." = cùng tên, alpn = giao thức, hint = địa chỉ. Cloudflare còn công bố khoá ech= ở đó (xem media.cuongthai.com ở bài 3.4).

exercises.problemHtml:
LabFlow's zone file on ns1 (lab/moi-truong/dns/vung/labflow.test.zone):

; labflow.test — LabFlow's zone on ns1 (203.0.113.53, primary). ns2 (203.0.113.54) copies it by AXFR when the SOA serial grows.
; To change it: edit a record + INCREASE the serial, then: bash /lab/k/moi-truong/dns/ky.sh labflow.test && rndc reload labflow.test
$TTL 300
@        3600  IN SOA  ns1.labflow.test. hostmaster.labflow.test. 2026110101 3600 600 1209600 300
@       86400  IN NS   ns1
@       86400  IN NS   ns2
ns1     86400  IN A    203.0.113.53
ns2     86400  IN A    203.0.113.54
; ns9: a name server that is dead (the DC router drops packets to .99) — the domain dead.test still points to it
ns9            IN A    203.0.113.99
; the main site — IPv4 and IPv6
@              IN A    203.0.113.10
@              IN AAAA 2001:db8:d::10
www            IN CNAME labflow.test.
; api: shorter TTL (120 s) — lesson 3.3 measures how long changing its IP takes
api       120  IN A    203.0.113.10
; static files go through a CDN: CNAME to the CDN's own name (they answer with an IP near the user)
static         IN CNAME labflow.cdn.test.
; mail: MX points to a NAME (never an IP) + SPF/DMARC (details in the Email infrastructure course)
@              IN MX   10 mail
mail           IN A    203.0.113.25
@              IN TXT  "v=spf1 mx -all"
@              IN TXT  "labflow-verify=7f3c9a1e"
_dmarc         IN TXT  "v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@labflow.test"
; only Let's Encrypt may issue certificates for this name
@              IN CAA  0 issue "letsencrypt.org"
; MongoDB cluster: the connection string mongodb+srv://db.labflow.test looks up SRV + TXT
_mongodb._tcp.db IN SRV 0 0 27017 db1
_mongodb._tcp.db IN SRV 0 0 27017 db2
db             IN TXT  "replicaSet=rs0&authSource=admin"
db1            IN A    203.0.113.31
db2            IN A    203.0.113.32
; HTTPS record (RFC 9460): browsers learn the ALPN protocol before connecting
@              IN HTTPS 1 . alpn="h2" ipv4hint=203.0.113.10
In a zone file, @ means the zone name (here labflow.test.), a name ending in a dot is complete, and any other name is relative: the zone name is appended.

# Records 2 — Read the SOA and the names of a zone file — answer key

1. The SOA line: @ 3600 IN SOA ns1.labflow.test. hostmaster.labflow.test. 2026110101 3600 600 1209600 300Dòng SOA
   - r1.v: ns1.labflow.test. / ns1.labflow.test
   - r1.m: who to contact / primary server
   - r2.v: 2026110101
   - r2.m: version of the zone
   - r3.v: 3600
   - r3.m: how often ns2 checks for a new version
   - r4.v: 600
   - r4.m: retry interval when that check fails
   - r5.v: 1209600
   - r5.m: when ns2 stops answering without the primary
   - r6.v: 300
   - r6.m: how long a "does not exist" may be cached
   The serial is the version number secondaries compare; YYYYMMDDnn is only a convention. EXPIRE 1 209 600 s = 14 days. The last field is no longer a minimum TTL: since RFC 2308 it is the negative-caching TTL (lesson 3.3). The 2nd field, hostmaster.labflow.test., is an e-mail address with the @ written as a dot.VI: Serial là số phiên bản mà máy phụ so sánh; YYYYMMDDnn chỉ là quy ước. EXPIRE 1 209 600 s = 14 ngày. Trường cuối không còn là TTL tối thiểu: từ RFC 2308 nó là TTL của cache âm (bài 3.3). Trường thứ 2, hostmaster.labflow.test., là địa chỉ e-mail với @ viết thành dấu chấm.

2. Write the full name each zone-file text stands for (with the final dot)Viết tên đầy đủ mà mỗi đoạn chữ trong tệp vùng biểu thị (có dấu chấm cuối)
   - r1.n: labflow.test.
   - r2.n: www.labflow.test.
   - r3.n: _mongodb._tcp.db.labflow.test.
   - r4.n: labflow.cdn.test.
   - r5.n: mail.labflow.test.

# Records 4 — Two name servers, one serial — answer key

1. The laptop's AXFR failed. Why is that the right behaviour?AXFR của laptop thất bại. Vì sao đó là hành vi đúng?
   Answer: c) AXFR copies the whole zone; only the secondary (allow-transfer) should get it
   An open AXFR hands anyone the full list of your names (internal hosts included). ns2 is allowed and holds the same serial.VI: AXFR mở cho ai cũng được là trao danh sách đủ mọi tên của bạn (cả máy nội bộ). ns2 được phép và giữ cùng serial.

2. After the change without a serial bump, ns1 says .11 and ns2 says .10. What do users get?Sau khi đổi mà không tăng serial, ns1 nói .11 còn ns2 nói .10. Người dùng nhận gì?
   Answer: b) A mix: users whose resolver asks ns2 get the old IP
   Resolvers spread queries over all NS. ns2 compares serials, sees the same number and keeps its old copy — until EXPIRE, two weeks later. The symptom is a "random" mix.VI: Resolver rải câu hỏi cho mọi NS. ns2 so serial, thấy cùng số và giữ bản cũ — tới EXPIRE, hai tuần sau. Triệu chứng là một mớ "ngẫu nhiên".

3. How did ns2 learn about serial 2026110102 within milliseconds?ns2 biết serial 2026110102 trong vài mili giây bằng cách nào?
   Answer: a) ns1 sent it a NOTIFY; ns2 saw a larger serial and transferred the zone
   "notify from 203.0.113.53: serial 2026110102", then "Transfer completed: 74 records, 5141 bytes". Without NOTIFY, ns2 would check after REFRESH = 3600 s.VI: "notify from 203.0.113.53: serial 2026110102", rồi "Transfer completed: 74 records, 5141 bytes". Không có NOTIFY, ns2 sẽ kiểm sau REFRESH = 3600 s.

4. The zone file has 23 records but the transfer moved 74. Why?Tệp vùng có 23 bản ghi mà lượt chép chuyển 74. Vì sao?
   Answer: b) The zone is signed: RRSIG, NSEC and DNSKEY records travel too
   DNSSEC (lesson 3.5) adds a signature per record set, NSEC links between names and the keys. You saw it filtered out with grep -v.VI: DNSSEC (bài 3.5) thêm một chữ ký cho mỗi bộ bản ghi, các liên kết NSEC giữa các tên và các khoá. Bạn đã thấy chúng bị lọc bằng grep -v.

5. cuongthai.com's serial is 2418592525. Is something wrong?Serial của cuongthai.com là 2418592525. Có gì sai không?
   Answer: c) No: YYYYMMDDnn is only a convention; Cloudflare uses its own counter
   Only "bigger = newer" matters (with serial arithmetic for wrap-around, RFC 1982). Managed DNS bumps it for you on every change.VI: Chỉ có "lớn hơn = mới hơn" là quan trọng (kèm phép tính serial khi quay vòng, RFC 1982). DNS được quản lý tự tăng nó mỗi lần đổi.

6. ANY to Cloudflare's server returned only `HINFO "RFC8482"`. What does that tell you?Hỏi ANY tới máy chủ của Cloudflare chỉ nhận `HINFO "RFC8482"`. Điều đó cho biết gì?
   Answer: c) Servers may refuse to list everything: ask for each type you need
   RFC 8482 lets servers answer ANY minimally — ANY was abused for amplification attacks. Tools that relied on ANY to "see all records" no longer work.VI: RFC 8482 cho máy chủ trả lời ANY tối giản — ANY từng bị lạm dụng cho tấn công khuếch đại. Công cụ dựa vào ANY để "xem mọi bản ghi" không còn dùng được.

luaChon.noiDung: Yes: it is larger than 2^31 and will wrap tomorrow
No: Cloudflare stores the expiry date of the domain there
No: YYYYMMDDnn is only a convention; Cloudflare uses its own counter
Yes: a serial must be a date, so secondaries ignore it

cauHoi.giaiThich:
Only "bigger = newer" matters (with serial arithmetic for wrap-around, RFC 1982). Managed DNS bumps it for you on every change.

ANY to Cloudflare's server returned only `HINFO "RFC8482"`. What does that tell you?

Hỏi ANY tới máy chủ của Cloudflare chỉ nhận `HINFO "RFC8482"`. Điều đó cho biết gì?

luaChon.noiDung: cuongthai.com has only one record
ANY works only with AXFR permission
Servers may refuse to list everything: ask for each type you need
The domain is broken and must be re-created

cauHoi.giaiThich:
RFC 8482 lets servers answer ANY minimally — ANY was abused for amplification attacks. Tools that relied on ANY to "see all records" no longer work.

exercises.problemHtml:
Write parseZone(text, origin) for zone files that have one record per line, like LabFlow's real file:

; labflow.test — LabFlow's zone on ns1 (203.0.113.53, primary). ns2 (203.0.113.54) copies it by AXFR when the SOA serial grows.
; To change it: edit a record + INCREASE the serial, then: bash /lab/k/moi-truong/dns/ky.sh labflow.test && rndc reload labflow.test
$TTL 300
@        3600  IN SOA  ns1.labflow.test. hostmaster.labflow.test. 2026110101 3600 600 1209600 300
@       86400  IN NS   ns1
@       86400  IN NS   ns2
ns1     86400  IN A    203.0.113.53
ns2     86400  IN A    203.0.113.54
; ns9: a name server that is dead (the DC router drops packets to .99) — the domain dead.test still points to it
ns9            IN A    203.0.113.99
; the main site — IPv4 and IPv6
@              IN A    203.0.113.10
@              IN AAAA 2001:db8:d::10
www            IN CNAME labflow.test.
; api: shorter TTL (120 s) — lesson 3.3 measures how long changing its IP takes
api       120  IN A    203.0.113.10
; static files go through a CDN: CNAME to the CDN's own name (they answer with an IP near the user)
static         IN CNAME labflow.cdn.test.
; mail: MX points to a NAME (never an IP) + SPF/DMARC (details in the Email infrastructure course)
@              IN MX   10 mail
mail           IN A    203.0.113.25
@              IN TXT  "v=spf1 mx -all"
@              IN TXT  "labflow-verify=7f3c9a1e"
_dmarc         IN TXT  "v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@labflow.test"
; only Let's Encrypt may issue certificates for this name
@              IN CAA  0 issue "letsencrypt.org"
; MongoDB cluster: the connection string mongodb+srv://db.labflow.test looks up SRV + TXT
_mongodb._tcp.db IN SRV 0 0 27017 db1
_mongodb._tcp.db IN SRV 0 0 27017 db2
db             IN TXT  "replicaSet=rs0&authSource=admin"
db1            IN A    203.0.113.31
db2            IN A    203.0.113.32
; HTTPS record (RFC 9460): browsers learn the ALPN protocol before connecting
@              IN HTTPS 1 . alpn="h2" ipv4hint=203.0.113.10

Return [{ name, ttl, type, data }] in file order:

  • comments start at ; — but a ; inside double quotes is text (look at the DMARC line); empty lines are skipped;
  • $TTL n sets the default TTL for the lines that follow;
  • a line is owner [ttl] [IN] TYPE data…: the owner is @ (= origin), a full name ending in ., or a relative name (append the origin); the optional number is the TTL;
  • name is always the full name with the final dot; data is the remaining words joined by one space, where the last word of CNAME, NS, MX, SRV and PTR is a name and becomes a full name too, and the first two words of SOA as well.

Example: @ IN MX 10 mail ⇒ { name: "labflow.test.", ttl: 300, type: "MX", data: "10 mail.labflow.test." }. Hidden cases: the broken copy of c32-kiem (the forgotten final dot) and a constructed zone with two $TTL lines and quotes containing ;.

Requirements

  • Return the value; do not print it.
  • Do not modify the arguments.

Trả về [{ name, ttl, type, data }] theo thứ tự trong tệp:

  • chú thích bắt đầu từ ; — nhưng ; nằm trong ngoặc kép là chữ (xem dòng DMARC); dòng trống bỏ qua;
  • $TTL n đặt TTL mặc định cho các dòng phía sau;

Ví dụ: @ IN MX 10 mail ⇒ { name: "labflow.test.", ttl: 300, type: "MX", data: "10 mail.labflow.test." }. Ca ẩn: bản hỏng của c32-kiem (quên dấu chấm cuối) và một vùng dựng có hai dòng $TTL và ngoặc kép chứa ;.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả về giá trị, đừng in ra.
  • Không sửa các đối số.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A zone file is shorthand: relative names, an implicit TTL and comments. Every tool (named, dig's AXFR output, your provider's API) works with the expanded form, so the bugs you meet — a doubled domain, the wrong TTL, a TXT cut in half — all live in this expansion step. Parsing it yourself is the quickest way to see why the final dot matters.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Tệp vùng là cách viết tắt: tên tương đối, TTL ngầm định và chú thích. Mọi công cụ (named, output AXFR của dig, API của nhà cung cấp) làm việc với dạng đã mở rộng, nên các lỗi bạn gặp — tên miền bị nhân đôi, TTL sai, TXT bị cắt đôi — đều nằm ở bước mở rộng này. Tự phân tích là cách nhanh nhất để thấy vì sao dấu chấm cuối quan trọng.

exercises.problemHtml:
Reproduce three checks of named-checkzone on records already expanded by parseZone() (exercise 5). The real messages (lab/out/c32-kiem):

$ named-checkzone labflow.test /dnsz/src/labflow.test.zone
zone labflow.test/IN: loaded serial 2026110101
OK
# 1) a CNAME at the apex — pointing labflow.test at the CDN's name
$ sed 's/^@              IN A    203.0.113.10/@              IN CNAME labflow.cdn.test./' /dnsz/src/labflow.test.zone > /tmp/apex.zone
$ named-checkzone labflow.test /tmp/apex.zone
dns_master_load: /tmp/apex.zone:13: labflow.test: CNAME and other data
dns_master_load: /tmp/apex.zone:20: labflow.test: CNAME and other data
dns_master_load: /tmp/apex.zone:23: labflow.test: CNAME and other data
dns_master_load: /tmp/apex.zone:26: labflow.test: CNAME and other data
dns_master_load: /tmp/apex.zone:34: labflow.test: CNAME and other data
zone labflow.test/IN: loading from master file /tmp/apex.zone failed: CNAME and other data
zone labflow.test/IN: not loaded due to errors.
# 2) a CNAME next to another record with the same name
$ printf 'api            IN CNAME labflow.test.\n' | cat /dnsz/src/labflow.test.zone - > /tmp/chung.zone
$ named-checkzone labflow.test /tmp/chung.zone
dns_master_load: /tmp/chung.zone:35: api.labflow.test: CNAME and other data
zone labflow.test/IN: loading from master file /tmp/chung.zone failed: CNAME and other data
zone labflow.test/IN: not loaded due to errors.
# 3) an MX pointing at an IP address instead of a name
$ sed 's/^@              IN MX   10 mail/@              IN MX   10 203.0.113.25./' /dnsz/src/labflow.test.zone > /tmp/mx.zone
$ named-checkzone labflow.test /tmp/mx.zone
/tmp/mx.zone:20: warning: '203.0.113.25.': MX is an address
zone labflow.test/IN: labflow.test/MX '203.0.113.25' (out of zone) has no addresses records (A or AAAA)
zone labflow.test/IN: loaded serial 2026110101
OK
# 4) a forgotten FINAL DOT: a name without it is RELATIVE ⇒ the domain gets appended
$ sed 's/^@              IN MX   10 mail$/@              IN MX   10 mail.labflow.test/' /dnsz/src/labflow.test.zone > /tmp/cham.zone
$ named-checkzone labflow.test /tmp/cham.zone
zone labflow.test/IN: labflow.test/MX 'mail.labflow.test.labflow.test' has no address records (A or AAAA)
zone labflow.test/IN: loaded serial 2026110101
OK

Write checkZone(records, origin) returning the unique messages sorted alphabetically (an empty array for a clean zone). Names in messages have no final dot:

  • a name that has a CNAME and any other type (RRSIG and NSEC excepted) ⇒ "<name>: CNAME and other data", once per name;
  • an MX whose target is an IPv4 address (with or without a final dot) ⇒ "'<target as written>': MX is an address", and no other check for that record;
  • an MX, NS or SRV whose target (the last word of data) is inside the zone — equal to the origin or ending in .<origin>. — but has no A or AAAA record ⇒ "<owner>/<TYPE> '<target>' has no address records (A or AAAA)". Targets outside the zone are not checked.

Cases are built from the real zone file exactly as c32-kiem did with sed (apex CNAME, CNAME next to A, MX to an address, forgotten dot), plus a constructed launch change with an NS and an SRV pointing to names that have no address.

Requirements

  • Return the value; do not print it.
  • Do not modify the arguments.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: These are the mistakes that break real domains silently: a zone that does not load, mail that bounces because MX points to nothing, a delegation to a name without an address. Running such checks in CI before every reload — the same idea as kiem-dns.sh in Lab 3 — turns an outage into a red build.

Chạy các phép kiểm như vậy trong CI trước mỗi lần nạp lại — cùng ý tưởng với kiem-dns.sh của Lab 3 — biến một sự cố thành một bản dựng đỏ.
